arms.a0-token-trivia-range: Token kinds, every exact token spelling, and every exact intertoken trivia gap use shared adaptive range-coded streams.
arms.a1-flat-identifiers: A0 with identifier spellings moved to a first-occurrence lexicon and occurrence events encoded by one global MTF list.
arms.a2-scope-bindings: A1 with only identifier occurrences replaced by scope-local NEW, lexical-ancestor or module-table FREE, and current-scope MTF events. The checkpoint accepts explicit synthetic scope plans only.

claim_ceiling: Corpus-disabled synthetic reference decoder and bitstream identity only. It is not the LibCST production encoder, a G0 result, a compression measurement, or a compression win.

coder.alphabet: Bytes produced by canonical uint64 varints and length-delimited byte strings.
coder.frequency_model: 256 symbols initialized to one, increment after each symbol, rescale at total 16384 by ceil(count/2).
coder.implementation: 32-bit range with 64-bit carry accumulator and canonical ShiftLow byte emission; renormalize while range is below 2^24; five final ShiftLow operations.
coder.name: axiom-int-range-v1

format.header: AXPG1 NUL magic, one arm byte, big-endian uint32 canonical-JSON header length, canonical JSON, then six directory-ordered range-coded streams.

name: source-python-gdb1-codec-format-v1
